ai_summary: Authum Investment & Infrastructure Limited is undergoing a significant strategic transformation, shifting from a pure-play investment firm to a diversified credit and alternative assets platform, marked by substantial fresh capital deployment in credit (over Rs. 4,100 Cr by Sep-26) and the acquisition of NBFCs and an ARC. This aggressive diversification has led to a doubling of total assets to over Rs. 23,200 Cr, funded by a substantial increase in borrowings including redeemable preference shares and inter-corporate deposits, indicating a shift towards a higher leverage profile. A critical red flag is the incomplete P&L statement provided, which prevents a full analysis of the financial performance and profitability of this rapidly expanding and potentially higher-risk credit business.
